{{Quote|There are a number of ways you can assist the clans and gain favor. Three come most readily to mind: gather herbs, eliminate enemies, and offer wisdom.|Rubina|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Rubina''' was a [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In c. [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with infiltrating either the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] or the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], the two dominant Dathomiri factions.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rubina appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and was added to the game in [[2010]], as part of the Witches of Dathomir Prologue quest series.
